text:
Ana - People Ops: Hey team — drafting a targeted 30/60/90 + first-week agenda for Elena (new Eng Manager, starts Mon). Sharing draft below; please flag any missing access or intro requests. https://redwood.example/onboard/elena :wave:

Priya: Quick Q — will she be on Dedicated or Hosted? infra access differs.

Miguel: Dedicated. Need to add her to `dedicated-eng` AD group and RGX cluster RBAC. @Ana can you confirm email? :eyes:

Ana - People Ops: elena@redwood.com — thanks. I added a ticket with infra: https://redwood.example/tickets/INF-4823

Sam: I'll take team intro + runbook walkthrough. Can do Wed 10am PT. Also suggest 30-min sync with product lead and 1:1 with each direct report in week 1.

Miguel: Infra checklist (quick):
```
- Add AD group: dedicated-eng
- Grant k8s cluster role: view/exec on namespaces team-*
- Access to Redwood Dedicated console
- GPU reservation request if needed
```

Priya: HR checklist: I have offer & docs done, benefits enrollment scheduled, send calendar invite for new-hire orientation Fri 9am PT. Please remind to complete I-9 and payroll forms.

onboard-bot: Preboarding status: email verified ✅, device requested ✅, SSO invite pending. Link: https://redwood.example/onboard/status/1819456789

Ana - People Ops: Draft 30/60/90 (suggested):
```
30: meet direct reports, own first two sprint plannings, complete infra access, shadow support rotation
60: lead team roadmap sync, start one cross-team initiative, set performance goals
90: deliver first stakeholder update, set hiring/coverage plan, assess tooling gaps
```

Sam: Add manager-specific expectations: weekly skip-level, OKR cadence ownership, monthly 1:1 with Eng Director.

Miguel: Who-to-ask quick map:
- infra: Miguel
- HR/payroll/benefits: Priya
- devex/keys & devices: Sam
- security/rdp: eng-security channel

Priya: Also remind about Redwood Code of Conduct and security training (complete by week 2).

Ana - People Ops: Awesome. Can folks reply with any blockers by EOD Friday? If none, I'll finalize and send calendar invites. :thumbsup:

Sam: LGTM.

Miguel: No blockers from infra side.

Priya: All good from HR.

Ana - People Ops: Thanks — will send final version and invites. Welcome pack: https://redwood.example/welcome-pack/elena
